# -within and -trim take several prefixes, separated by commas or white space,
# so that the output of "go list -m" in a workspace can be passed unedited.
# (Newline separation is covered by TestPrefixes; a script argument is one line.)
calltree -within=example.com/m,example.com/m-lm -trim=example.com/m.,example.com/m-lm. -f graph.txt
cmp stdout want.txt

# A longer prefix is removed first, so that trimming example.com/m. does not
# leave "-lm.Model" behind.
stdout '\(\*Model\)\.Forward'

-- graph.txt --
example.com/m.main	example.com/m.run
example.com/m.run	(*example.com/m-lm.Model).Forward
example.com/m.run	example.com/other.Helper
-- want.txt --
main
  -> run
    -> (*Model).Forward
